fundamental.name: Toss The Coin Ltd
pros: Stock is providing a good dividend yield of 3.75%.
Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 19.1%
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 34.8%
Debtor days have improved from 74.3 to 58.8 days.
